title: Be Good For
subtitle: 「對……有益／有幫助／有利」，按『健康、幫助、改善、優勢』等效果類型細分。
description: 「對……有益／有幫助／有利」，按『健康、幫助、改善、優勢』等效果類型細分。

words.example: Regular exercise benefits both physical and mental health.
words.exampleZh: 定期運動對身心健康都有益。

exercises.original: Regular exercise is good for both physical and mental health.
exercises.zh: 定期運動對身心健康都有益。
exercises.upgrade: Regular exercise benefits both physical and mental health.

options.explanation: 直接表示運動對身心健康產生正面作用，最貼切。
cure 表示治癒疾病，語義過強，原句只說有益。
health 不會『需要 exercise』以這種句法表達。
運動可能保護健康，但 protect 比原句更具體。

exercises.original: Reading every day is good for children's language development.
exercises.zh: 每天閱讀有益兒童語言發展。
exercises.upgrade: Reading every day benefits children's language development.

options.explanation: 也接近，但題目要最直接改寫『有益』，benefits 更等值。
直接接 language development，語法和語義都自然。

exercises.original: The new policy should be good for small businesses.
exercises.zh: 新政策應該對小企業有利。
exercises.upgrade: The new policy should benefit small businesses.

options.explanation: 政策可能保護企業，但原句只是廣義有利。
business context 中 benefit 是最直接替代。

words.example: A balanced diet is beneficial to long-term health.
words.exampleZh: 均衡飲食有益長遠健康。

exercises.original: A balanced diet is good for long-term health.
exercises.zh: 均衡飲食有益長遠健康。
exercises.upgrade: A balanced diet is beneficial to long-term health.

options.explanation: 正式、直接表達對長遠健康有益。
只表示適合，不一定有健康益處。
good at 表示擅長，句法和意思都錯。
語義過窄，原句未限定為保護作用。

exercises.original: Group discussion can be good for students' understanding.
exercises.zh: 小組討論有助學生理解。
exercises.upgrade: Group discussion can be beneficial for students' understanding.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 beneficial for 更直接對應整體『有益』。
正式地表示對理解有正面作用。

exercises.original: Lower noise levels are good for concentration.
exercises.zh: 較低噪音水平有助專注。
exercises.upgrade: Lower noise levels are beneficial to concentration.

options.explanation: 對 concentration 有正面作用。

words.example: Reading regularly can help improve vocabulary.
words.exampleZh: 定期閱讀有助改善詞彙量。

exercises.original: Short breaks are good for improving concentration.
exercises.zh: 短暫休息有助改善專注力。
exercises.upgrade: Short breaks help improve concentration.

options.explanation: 原句本身已有 improving，help improve 最自然表達促成改善。

exercises.original: Regular revision is good for remembering new vocabulary.
exercises.zh: 定期溫習有助記住新詞彙。
exercises.upgrade: Regular revision helps students remember new vocabulary.

options.explanation: 明確表達溫習促進記憶。

exercises.original: Fresh air can be good for recovery after a long day indoors.
exercises.zh: 長時間留在室內後，呼吸新鮮空氣有助恢復精神。
exercises.upgrade: Fresh air can help recovery after a long day indoors.

options.explanation: fresh air 不會『需要恢復』。

words.example: Visual examples are helpful for learning new vocabulary.
words.exampleZh: 視覺例子對學習新詞彙很有幫助。

exercises.original: Visual diagrams are good for learning complex processes.
exercises.zh: 視覺圖表對學習複雜流程很有幫助。
exercises.upgrade: Visual diagrams are helpful for learning complex processes.

options.explanation: diagrams 作為學習工具，helpful 最自然。

exercises.original: This checklist is good for preparing for the interview.
exercises.zh: 這份清單對準備面試很有幫助。
exercises.upgrade: This checklist is helpful for preparing for the interview.

options.explanation: 可成立，但只說適合用途，不如 helpful 直接表達幫助。
checklist 的實際用途正是幫助準備面試。

exercises.original: Extra examples are good for students who are still confused.
exercises.zh: 額外例子對仍感困惑的學生很有幫助。
exercises.upgrade: Extra examples are helpful to students who are still confused.

options.explanation: 搭配和意思都不如 helpful。
對 confused students 提供實際幫助。

words.example: Walking every day is healthy for both the body and mind.
words.exampleZh: 每天步行對身心都有益。

exercises.original: Eating more vegetables is good for your heart.
exercises.zh: 多吃蔬菜對心臟健康有益。
exercises.upgrade: Eating more vegetables is healthy for your heart.

options.explanation: 太一般，沒有直接健康意味。

exercises.original: Regular sleep is good for the brain.
exercises.zh: 規律睡眠對腦部健康有益。
exercises.upgrade: Regular sleep is healthy for the brain.

options.explanation: 對腦部健康有益最自然。

exercises.original: Spending time outdoors can be good for children's mental health.
exercises.zh: 戶外活動有益兒童精神健康。
exercises.upgrade: Spending time outdoors can be healthy for children's mental health.

options.explanation: 也可，但 mental health 明確支持 healthy。
直接聚焦健康正面作用。

words.example: Flexible scheduling can be advantageous for working parents.
words.exampleZh: 彈性時間安排對在職父母有利。

exercises.original: Flexible hours can be good for working parents.
exercises.zh: 彈性工時對在職父母有利。
exercises.upgrade: Flexible hours can be advantageous for working parents.

options.explanation: flexible hours 帶來實際安排上的優勢。

exercises.original: The tax change may be good for small exporters.
exercises.zh: 稅制改變可能對小型出口商有利。
exercises.upgrade: The tax change may be advantageous to small exporters.

options.explanation: 也可，但商業／政策利益語境 advantageous 更精準。
表示帶來競爭或財務優勢。

exercises.original: Starting early is good for applicants in a competitive process.
exercises.zh: 在競爭激烈的申請過程中，提早開始對申請人有利。
exercises.upgrade: Starting early is advantageous for applicants in a competitive process.

options.explanation: 也有幫助，但 competitive process 強調優勢。
表示讓申請人處於更有利位置。

words.example: The checklist is useful for preparing for the interview.
words.exampleZh: 這份清單對準備面試很有用。

exercises.original: This guide is good for planning a short trip.
exercises.zh: 這本指南對規劃短途旅程很有用。
exercises.upgrade: This guide is useful for planning a short trip.

options.explanation: guide 的實際用途最自然用 useful。

exercises.original: The chart is good for comparing the two options quickly.
exercises.zh: 圖表對快速比較兩個選項很有用。
exercises.upgrade: The chart is useful for comparing the two options quickly.

options.explanation: 可說 helpful to users，但此句 for comparing 最適合 useful for。

exercises.original: These notes will be good for revision before the exam.
exercises.zh: 這些筆記對考試前溫習很有用。
exercises.upgrade: These notes will be useful for revision before the exam.

options.explanation: notes + revision 是典型實用性語境。

words.example: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function.
words.exampleZh: 充足睡眠有助維持健康的腦部功能。

exercises.original: Adequate sleep is good for healthy brain function.
exercises.zh: 充足睡眠有助維持健康的腦部功能。
exercises.upgrade: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function.

options.explanation: 表示睡眠有助維持正常健康功能。

exercises.original: Regular feedback is good for student learning.
exercises.zh: 定期回饋有助學生學習。
exercises.upgrade: Regular feedback supports student learning.

options.explanation: 也可能，但 support 更穩妥地表達持續幫助學習。
education 語境中 support learning 很自然。

exercises.original: A stable routine can be good for recovery.
exercises.zh: 穩定作息有助康復。
exercises.upgrade: A stable routine can support recovery.

options.explanation: 表示有助維持和促進康復過程。

words.exampleZh: 定時休息可以改善專注力。

exercises.original: Regular breaks are good for concentration.
exercises.zh: 定時休息有助改善專注力。
exercises.upgrade: Regular breaks can improve concentration.

options.explanation: concentration 可直接變得更好，精準表達效果。

exercises.original: Daily practice is good for pronunciation.
exercises.zh: 每天練習有助改善發音。
exercises.upgrade: Daily practice can improve pronunciation.

options.explanation: 可說 support learning，但 pronunciation 直接用 improve 更自然。

exercises.original: More natural light can be good for employees' mood.
exercises.zh: 更多自然光有助改善員工情緒。
exercises.upgrade: More natural light can improve employees' mood.

options.explanation: 可 promote wellbeing，但直接接 mood 不如 improve 自然。

words.example: Outdoor play promotes healthy development in children.
words.exampleZh: 戶外遊戲有助促進兒童健康發展。

exercises.original: Outdoor play is good for healthy development in children.
exercises.zh: 戶外遊戲有助促進兒童健康發展。
exercises.upgrade: Outdoor play promotes healthy development in children.

options.explanation: healthy development 是典型 promote 搭配。

exercises.original: Group activities are good for cooperation.
exercises.zh: 小組活動有助促進合作。
exercises.upgrade: Group activities promote cooperation.

options.explanation: 也可，但 promote cooperation 更自然表達鼓勵合作形成。
cooperation 是可被促進的社會行為。

exercises.original: A calm classroom environment is good for learning.
exercises.zh: 平靜的課堂環境有助促進學習。
exercises.upgrade: A calm classroom environment promotes learning.

options.explanation: 也合理，但題目聚焦積極促進學習，promotes 更直接。

words.example: Strong social connections contribute to better mental health.
words.exampleZh: 穩固社交聯繫有助改善精神健康。

exercises.original: Strong friendships are good for mental wellbeing.
exercises.zh: 穩固友誼有助精神健康。
exercises.upgrade: Strong friendships contribute to mental wellbeing.

options.explanation: 友誼是 wellbeing 的其中一個正面因素。

exercises.original: Regular exercise is good for better sleep quality.
exercises.zh: 定期運動有助改善睡眠質素。
exercises.upgrade: Regular exercise contributes to better sleep quality.

options.explanation: 也可，但 contribute to 更突出它是多個影響睡眠因素之一。
表示運動促成更佳睡眠。

exercises.original: Clear communication is good for a successful team.
exercises.zh: 清晰溝通有助團隊成功。
exercises.upgrade: Clear communication contributes to a successful team.

options.explanation: 通常要說 improve teamwork/performance，不直接 improve a successful team。
也合理，但 contribute to 更自然地表示其中一項成功因素。
對團隊成功作出正面貢獻。

words.meaning: 對某人有好處；令某人受益
words.example: A short walk outside would do you good.
words.exampleZh: 到外面短暫散步會對你有好處。

exercises.original: A short walk outside would be good for you.
exercises.zh: 到外面短暫散步會對你有好處。
exercises.upgrade: A short walk outside would do you good.

options.explanation: 是非常自然的口語固定表達，表示對你有益。
通常表示令你變乖／變好，不是同義。

exercises.original: Some fresh air might be good for him after a long day indoors.
exercises.zh: 長時間留在室內後，呼吸新鮮空氣可能對他有好處。
exercises.upgrade: Some fresh air might do him good after a long day indoors.

options.explanation: 意思接近但較一般，沒有固定口語語感。
fresh air + person 是典型 do someone good 語境。

exercises.original: A few days of rest would be good for her.
exercises.zh: 休息幾天會對她有好處。
exercises.upgrade: A few days of rest would do her good.

options.explanation: rest 對人的正面作用，口語非常自然。
適合她不等於對她有益。

words.example: Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on mood.
words.exampleZh: 定期接觸大自然可以對情緒產生正面影響。

exercises.original: Regular contact with nature can be good for mood.
exercises.zh: 定期接觸大自然可以對情緒產生正面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on mood.

options.explanation: 是 be good for 的正式透明改寫。
被喜歡不等於有正面影響。
mood 不是可被『治癒』的對象。
適合不等於造成正面效果。

exercises.original: The mentoring programme was good for students' confidence.
exercises.zh: 導師計劃對學生自信有正面影響。
exercises.upgrade: The mentoring programme had a positive effect on students' confidence.

options.explanation: 正式、精準地表達 confidence 受正面影響。

exercises.original: Lower noise levels are good for work performance.
exercises.zh: 較低噪音水平對工作表現有正面影響。
exercises.upgrade: Lower noise levels have a positive effect on work performance.

options.explanation: noise levels 不是工具，語氣不自然。
work performance 是典型研究／分析搭配。

words.example: Flexible hours are a real plus for employees with young children.
words.exampleZh: 彈性工時對有年幼子女的員工是一大優點。

exercises.original: Flexible hours are good for employees with young children.
exercises.zh: 彈性工時對有年幼子女的員工是一項優點。
exercises.upgrade: Flexible hours are a real plus for employees with young children.

options.explanation: 工作條件帶來額外優勢，口語自然。

exercises.original: Free parking would be good for customers.
exercises.zh: 免費泊車對顧客是一項加分。
exercises.upgrade: Free parking would be a plus for customers.

options.explanation: 可成立，但題目強調 feature/advantage，a plus 更貼切。
免費泊車是典型加分項。

exercises.original: The extra storage space is good for families.
exercises.zh: 額外儲物空間對家庭來說是一項優點。
exercises.upgrade: The extra storage space is a definite plus for families.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 housing feature 語境中 a plus 更自然地表示優點。
extra feature + families 是典型優勢語境。

falseSynonyms.zh: 擅長不等於有益 be good at 表示某人擅長某事；be good for 表示某事對某人／某物有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is good at maths; exercise is good for her health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 善待不等於有益 be good to someone 通常表示善待某人；be good for someone 表示對某人有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is good to his staff; regular rest is good for staff wellbeing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 享受不等於受益 enjoy 表示喜歡或享受某事；喜歡某事不代表它一定有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People may enjoy something that is not especially good for them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 喜歡不等於有益 like 表示偏好；be good for 描述正面效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can like a food even if it is not good for your health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 需要不等於有益 need 表示必需；某事有益不代表它是必需品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Something can be beneficial without being necessary.

falseSynonyms.zh: 適合不等於有益 suitable 表示匹配用途或情況；good for 強調正面效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A tool may be suitable for a task without providing a wider benefit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 保護不等於一般有益 protect 是防止傷害；它可以是一種益處，但語義比 be good for 更具體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sunscreen protects the skin; that protection is one reason it is good for skin health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 治癒不等於有益 cure 表示消除疾病；be good for health 只表示有益，不能推出治療效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A healthy habit may benefit health without curing a disease.
